exercises.title: Three ways to reach inside a document
exercises.problemHtml:
For every product return name, brand, ram: brand as text, ram (inside specs) as an integer — NULL when the product has no specs. Order by id.

Sample table (lesson 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 rows:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}
 3 Phone X        {"brand":"Zeta","price":799,"tags":["phone"],"specs":{"ram":8,"storage":256}}
 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← no specs

Requirements

  • props ->> 'brand'; (props -> 'specs' ->> 'ram')::int (or (props #>> '{specs,ram}')::int).
  • ram must be an int so it can be compared and summed.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Với mọi sản phẩm trả về name, brand, ram: brand dạng chữ, ram (nằm trong specs) dạng số nguyên — NULL khi sản phẩm không có specs. Sắp theo id.

Bảng mẫu (bài 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 dòng:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}
 3 Phone X        {"brand":"Zeta","price":799,"tags":["phone"],"specs":{"ram":8,"storage":256}}
 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← không có specs

Yêu cầu

  • props ->> 'brand'; (props -> 'specs' ->> 'ram')::int (hoặc (props #>> '{specs,ram}')::int).
  • ram phải là int để so sánh và cộng được.

exercises.title: Change one key without rewriting the document: jsonb_set
exercises.problemHtml:
Zeta raises its prices by 10 % (rounded to an integer). Update props.price of every Zeta product — keep every other key exactly as it is — and return name, price (the new price as an integer).

Sample table (lesson 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 rows:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}
 3 Phone X        {"brand":"Zeta","price":799,"tags":["phone"],"specs":{"ram":8,"storage":256}}
 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← no specs

Requirements

  • SET props = jsonb_set(props, '{price}', to_jsonb(round((props->>'price')::numeric * 1.1)::int)).
  • Filter with props @> '{"brand": "Zeta"}'.

Yêu cầu

exercises.title: Build JSON for the API: jsonb_agg per brand
exercises.problemHtml:
The API wants one row per brand: brand and products, a JSON array of objects {"name": …, "price": …} sorted by price (cheapest first). Order the rows by brand.

Sample table (lesson 13.1)

product (id identity PK, name, props jsonb) — 5 rows:
 1 Laptop Pro 14  {"brand":"Acme","price":1299,"tags":["laptop","pro"],"specs":{"ram":16,"cpu":"M3"}}
 2 Laptop Air 13  {"brand":"Acme","price":999,"tags":["laptop","light"],"specs":{"ram":8,"cpu":"M2"}}

 4 Tablet Mini    {"brand":"Zeta","price":449,"tags":["tablet","light"],"specs":{"ram":4}}
 5 Keyboard K1    {"brand":"Acme","price":89,"tags":["accessory"]}   ← no specs

Requirements

  • jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', name, 'price', (props->>'price')::int) ORDER BY (props->>'price')::int).
  • price as a JSON number, not a string.

exercises.title: Count products per tag (CT Shop attrs)
exercises.problemHtml:
Each CT Shop product carries attrs->'tags', a JSON array such as ["học sinh", "sinh viên"]. Return tag, products — how many active products carry each tag — most products first (ties by tag).

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

Requirements

  • Unnest the array: FROM product p, jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs->'tags') AS t(tag).
  • Products without tags simply produce no rows.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
Mỗi sản phẩm CT Shop mang attrs->'tags', một mảng JSON như ["học sinh", "sinh viên"]. Trả về tag, products — mỗi thẻ có bao nhiêu sản phẩm đang bán — nhiều nhất trước (bằng nhau theo tag).

CSDL mẫu: CT Shop mini (dự án lab của khoá, cắt nhỏ)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

Yêu cầu

  • Tách mảng: FROM product p, jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs->'tags') AS t(tag).
  • Sản phẩm không có thẻ đơn giản là không sinh dòng nào.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT t.tag, count(*) AS products
FROM product p,
     jsonb_array_elements_text(p.attrs -> 'tags') AS t(tag)   -- one row per (product, tag)
WHERE p.is_active
GROUP BY t.tag
ORDER BY products DESC, t.tag;

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

# json or jsonb, column or document? — answer key

1. SELECT '{"b":1,"a":2,"a":3}'::jsonb; returns…SELECT '{"b":1,"a":2,"a":3}'::jsonb; trả về…
   Answer: b) {"a": 3, "b": 1} — keys reordered, the last duplicate wins
   jsonb stores a parsed, normalized value; json stores the text as typed. jsonb is what you index and query.VI: jsonb lưu giá trị đã phân tích, chuẩn hoá; json lưu nguyên văn chữ. jsonb là thứ bạn đánh chỉ mục và truy vấn.

2. Every order has a customer_id that must reference customer. Where does it belong?Mỗi đơn có customer_id phải trỏ tới customer. Nó thuộc về đâu?
   Answer: c) a real column with a foreign key
   Anything you join on, constrain, or always query belongs in a column; JSONB is for the varying rest.VI: Thứ gì bạn nối theo, ràng buộc, hay luôn truy vấn thì thuộc về cột; JSONB dành cho phần còn lại hay thay đổi.

3. Product attributes differ per category (ink colour, pages, calculator functions). Best model?Thuộc tính sản phẩm khác nhau theo danh mục (màu mực, số trang, chức năng máy tính). Mô hình tốt nhất?
   Answer: a) common columns + one jsonb attrs column (CT Shop's choice)
   jsonb keeps the varying part flexible while price, stock, category stay typed columns. EAV loses types and needs a join per attribute.VI: jsonb giữ phần thay đổi linh hoạt trong khi price, stock, category vẫn là cột có kiểu. EAV mất kiểu và cần một phép nối cho mỗi thuộc tính.
